summary: Own or explicitly exclude unpublishable root paths (CHANGELOG, .env.example)

delivery.outcome: Adopt a new immutable new-project release that includes the 0.12.0 root ownership contract and a narrow provenance-bound atomic-adoption budget rule
nonGoals: No silent ownership expansion without standard alignment
No standalone mutation of hash-locked managed files outside the reviewed adoption transaction
No moving tag or branch-based adoption
No general increase of todo2code's implementation-file budget

architecture.decision: Keep upstream Option A, but first add a narrow upstream rule that accounts for a complete provenance-bound managed-file adoption atomically; publish and adopt a new immutable release

components.name: upstream-standard
paths: wellmanifest/new-project governance manifest and regression tests

interfaceChanges: The governance workstream becomes the sole owner of CHANGELOG.md and .env.example
dataChanges: The governance lock will advance from 0.11.0 to a new immutable release that contains the 0.12.0 ownership contract and atomic-adoption rule
architecture.rollback: Adopt the prior immutable source revision through the same reviewed Goal flow; never move or rewrite a release tag

validation.evidence: Managed ownership declarations and target intent pass governance validation

commands: upstream tests/governance-validator.test.sh at the approved release
